summary: Stellantis N.V. filed a Form 6-K, a report of foreign private issuer, furnishing a press release of its Q1 2026 financial results. The filing contains no transaction or event meeting special-situation criteria. It presents routine quarterly earnings, net revenues of €38.1B, net profit of €0.4B, and reaffirmed 2026 guidance. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is disclosed. The press release merely announces financial performance and an upcoming investor day.
